# WiseLake (와이즈레이크)

> WiseLake, Inc. (㈜와이즈레이크) is a Korean technology company — Data Moves. Value Follows. It builds AI for pig farms and global data and content technology: PigPlan and PigPlan AI in Korea, PigOS worldwide, and NanoTrans for content value in the AI era.

## Products

- [PigPlan and PigPlan AI](https://wiselake.ai/pigplan): PigPlan is a pig-farm management system for Korean farms (technology since 1995, 700 farms; web, Android and iOS). PigPlan Biz is a business-management add-on (opens December 2026). PigPlan AI is AI for pig farms: weekly and monthly reports with nationwide comparison are live; chat questions open December 2026. Service page: https://pigplan.io/landing/service.do. Korea only.
- [PigOS](https://pigos.io): Operating platform for pig farms worldwide — farm records, performance analytics, country benchmarks and early warnings. Core is free; 7 languages; Android and iOS apps (iOS since October 2026).
- [NanoTrans](https://nanotrans.io): Technology that measures how AI uses content, lets content owners manage access and usage policies, and develops content value exchange models. In development, piloting with a Korean IT and business news publisher.

## Company

- Name: WiseLake, Inc. (㈜와이즈레이크), founded January 28, 2022. PigPlan's technology began in 1995.
- Address: Suite 505 (5F), The H Tower 919, 80 Beolmal-ro, Dongan-gu, Anyang-si, Gyeonggi-do, Republic of Korea
- Contact: wiselake@wiselake.ai (email only)
